AI Agent Engineer — Atlas Learning (EdTech, Remote/Cairo hybrid)

We're building an AI-powered tutoring platform and looking for an AI Agent Engineer
to design and ship multi-agent workflows that power our virtual lab simulations.

Required:
- 2+ years of experience with Python in a production setting
- Hands-on experience with LangGraph or a comparable agent orchestration framework
- Experience building RAG pipelines with a vector store (FAISS, Chroma, or similar)
- Comfortable shipping FastAPI or similar inference APIs

Nice to have:
- Experience with voice AI or real-time audio pipelines (LiveKit, WebRTC)
- Familiarity with edge deployment or resource-constrained inference
- Exposure to CrewAI or other multi-agent frameworks

You'll work closely with our curriculum team to turn subject-matter content into
agent-driven learning experiences. We're a small, fast-moving team — comfortable
with ambiguity and owning a feature end to end.
